title: Fix Framework Core Ts-rs Typegen Pipeline
description:
Follow-up from the closed UNIVERSAL-UI-ELEMENT-ID-SYSTEM ticket (26/07/22): `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-core:generate` (== `cargo test --features typegen exports_typescript_bindings` in framework/core/rs) was reported failing with `error: ts(optional) can only be used on an Option<T> type` on IntroductionStepDefinition.cutouts (Vec<IntroductionAnchor>, framework/core/rs/lib.rs). That session hand-patched framework/core/js/generated/manifest.ts's one changed line (slot->element rename) to unblock TS compilation while typegen was broken, without regenerating for real. Also flagged: a wave of "failed to parse serde attribute" warnings (serde(transparent), serde(skip_serializing_if)) during the same run — check if cosmetic or symptomatic of ts-rs version drift (Cargo.toml pins ts-rs = "10", resolved 10.1.0 in Cargo.lock).

Task: get `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-core:generate` passing for real and confirm the freshly regenerated manifest.ts matches (no drift from) the hand-patched version, or update it if it doesn't. Verify project.json's generate/check targets (added in the prior ticket) work end-to-end.
summary:
Investigated the reported ts-rs typegen failure (`ts(optional) can only be used on an Option<T> type` on `IntroductionStepDefinition.cutouts`). Confirmed it no longer reproduces — a concurrent session already removed the offending `ts(optional)` attribute from that `Vec<IntroductionAnchor>` field before this ticket started; swept `framework/core/rs/lib.rs` for other misuses, found none. Ran `cargo test --features typegen exports_typescript_bindings` directly and via `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-core:generate` — zero `ts(optional)` errors in either.

Also resolved the open question about the "failed to parse serde attribute" warning wave (`serde(transparent)`, `skip_serializing_if`): confirmed via ts-rs 10.1.0 docs these are cosmetic, non-fatal warnings for serde attributes outside ts-rs's supported allowlist — no version drift, no bump needed. Spot-checked `ActionRef(String)` (`#[serde(transparent)]`) and confirmed its generated binding is already correct (`export type ActionRef = string;`) since ts-rs natively unwraps single-field tuple structs.

The `generate` pipeline still fails end-to-end, but for an unrelated reason outside this ticket's scope: framework-core's `typegen` Cargo feature unconditionally pulls in `ui_wgpu/typegen`, and `ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs` currently has another session's active, uncommitted work-in-progress (threading a new `waiting: Option<bool>` field through several UiNode structs — ticket `26/07/23/WAITING-STATE-FOR-ALL-UI-ELEMENTS`, still open, actively iterating between my two attempts). Did not touch that file to avoid racing with that session. Real manifest regeneration and drift-check against the hand-patched `framework/core/js/generated/manifest.ts` is deferred until that other ticket lands.
